expectations.text: The firmware detects gestures in software from the IMU (M5.Imu / MPU6886 accelerometer), since the MPU6886 has no on-chip gesture engine
expectations.evidence: StickCP2_Sword.ino:185 reads M5.Imu.getAccel at 200 Hz and detects in software

expectations.text: The swing (slash) detector requires acceleration above a threshold for a minimum duration or uses a lockout, so a tap knock is not counted as a slash
expectations.evidence: HIGH_G_G 3.0 g for HIGH_G_MS 50 ms plus 400 ms lock

expectations.text: Lay-flat detection uses hysteresis (separate on/off thresholds) or a hold time, and the event is sent only on state change
expectations.evidence: FLAT_ON_Z 0.90 / FLAT_OFF_Z 0.75 hysteresis plus stillness; FLAT 1/0 sent on change

expectations.text: The firmware sends small named event packets (event id + code) over a BLE notify characteristic rather than streaming raw sensor data
Advertising puts the custom service UUID in the advertising data so the browser can filter by it
expectations.evidence: setCompleteServices(SVC_UUID) in advertising, name in scan response

expectations.text: The web page connects with navigator.bluetooth.requestDevice filtered by the service UUID and subscribes to notifications
The web game has a keyboard mode that triggers the same events (slash, pause/flat, special attack) through the same handler as BLE
expectations.evidence: KEYS map H/Enter slash, Space special, F flat through same handler

expectations.text: The answer tells the user which Arduino board and libraries to select (M5StickCPlus2 board, M5Unified) and that Web Bluetooth needs Chrome/Edge over HTTPS or localhost
expectations.evidence: answer.md: M5StickCPlus2 board, M5Unified, Chrome/Edge, https or localhost
